notes.title: Play the Pantless Demo at Steam Next Fest 2024!
notes.notes:
[h2]Hey Pantless people![/h2]

The Steam Next Fest has arrived, and we are thrilled to have a super exciting week full of Pantless joys. Go ahead and enjoy the demo and let us know what you think!

[h2]In the demo you can:[/h2]
[list]
[*] Play multiplayer
[*] Explore the beautiful first level
[*] No time limitation
[*] Get trash talked by the narrator
[/list]

We'll stay active in the Discord to interact with you live, and we'll see you there!
